cn.t: Critics are mixed on Clooney's Broadway debut, praising the timely subject and polished production but finding the faithful film adaptation overly didactic and dramatically inert, with excessive video close-ups undermining the theatrical experience.

vs.sum: The Winter Garden Theatre offers excellent legroom and spacious seating, making it one of the most comfortable venues on Broadway. Sightlines are generally good, though some side seats may have partial obstructions. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its historical charm and garden-themed decor, while facilities are average with some potential for lines at restrooms.

acc.note: 20 wheelchair spaces (largest of Shubert theaters). 16 aisle transfer seats. Infrared devices available.
